offering_description.value: Provides aftermarket products and services for commercial aircraft, engines and components. It sells used serviceable material, aircraft and engines, leases assets, and performs maintenance, repair, overhaul and engineering solutions for airlines, lessors and MRO providers.

primary_products.value: used serviceable aircraft parts; aircraft and engines for sale; landing gear and component kits; aircraft performance enhancement kits

primary_services.value: maintenance, repair and overhaul; aircraft and engine teardown; component repair and overhaul; aircraft modification and engineering; aircraft and engine leasing

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial airlines, aircraft lessors, MRO providers and cargo operators; B2G: government and military aircraft operators

end_markets.value: commercial aviation; air cargo; government and defense aviation

revenue_model.value: product sales: used serviceable material, aircraft, engines and performance kits; rental or leasing: lease of aircraft and engines; service fees: maintenance, repair, overhaul and engineering services
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: distributor: acquires used aircraft and engines, disassembles and sells parts to airlines and MRO shops; service provider: MRO and component repair for airline and lessor customers; asset operator: owns and leases aircraft and engines to airlines; OEM / manufacturer: develops proprietary performance enhancement and modification kits sold to operators
value_chain_position.category: distributor; service provider; asset operator; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: Customers worldwide, operations in US sites such as Florida, Indiana, California and Ohio

specialization.value: related lines: Asset management, used material sales, and MRO/engineering for commercial aircraft

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to airlines, lessors and MROs; online: parts catalog and inventory listings

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA and EASA repair station certifications and airworthiness approvals for parts, maintenance and modifications
